context: User-observed ChatGPT execution interruptions during Powerhouse work, including network loss, interrupted streaming, failed reasoning and unexpected stop of reasoning.
failed_pattern: Treating a chat/model/stream lifetime as the lifetime and source of truth of the underlying task.
fix: Move task continuity to canonical durable Powerhouse state with checkpoints, obligations, heartbeat/watchdog detection, side-effect readback, idempotency/dedupe guards, bounded retries and explicit recovery state.
prevention: Every material chat and agent must ingest powerhouse-execution-resilience-v1 via the existing chat-learning preflight; an interrupted non-terminal run becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED and may resume only after canonical state and side-effect reconciliation.

evidence.local_regression_run: 6/6 PASS after expanding interruption classifier to recognize Dutch network wording
evidence.important_test_learning: The first regression run failed because the classifier only recognized English network terms. The test correctly exposed a localization gap; network/netwerk/verbinding matching was then added and the suite passed.
evidence.ci_coverage_learning: Shared Agent Memory CI correctly failed when the new resilience test was not selected by any workflow. The test was moved into the existing *guard*.test.mjs regression family so future changes are automatically executed by governed CI instead of relying on a one-off workflow edit.
